ProjectSample.description:
A pad's sample in a project: the file it plays (a path, as in v7, for
all of it), or a region of it and where a bundle's copy came from.

origin.description:
For the bundle's copy of a region: the file and region it was cut
from (on the engine host that saved it).

start.description: Seconds of the file (default: all of it).

path.description:
Engine-side bundle path (e.g. `songs/beat.4s`). Relative paths resolve
under the daemon's data dir. Defaults to the current project path.

ProjectTrack.description: An instrument's track in a project file.

arrangement.description: Placements on the song timeline, by start.

launched.description: The clip the track loops instead of its arrangement (RFC 0009).

RecordMode.description: How a recording pass treats the notes already in the clip.

oneOf.description: Add to what is there.
Each pass clears the part of the loop it passes over.

RecordParams.description:
Arm or disarm recording, or change its settings. Settings left out keep
their current values.

arm.description:
`true` starts recording (and the transport, after the count-in, if
stopped); `false` ends it, keeping what was played.

count_in.description: Bars of metronome before recording starts from a stop (0..4).

instrument.description: Instrument to record into. Default: the caller's seat focus.

offset_ms.description:
Extra input latency to compensate, in milliseconds (0..500): notes
are placed this much earlier.

quantize.description: Record quantize grid in ticks (24 = a 16th); 0 turns it off.

strength.description: How far record quantize moves notes toward the grid, 0..1.

RenderNote.description: A note played into an offline render, timed from the start of playback.

from.description: Song tick to start from (default: the locate point).

input.description:
Notes to play during the render, as a player would (RFC 0008). They
go to `record.instrument`, else the caller's seat focus.

metronome.description: Include the metronome click (default off, whatever `metronome.on` is).

path.description: Engine-side WAV path. Relative paths resolve under the data dir.

record.description:
Record `input` with these settings (`arm` is ignored) and return the
clip it would leave; the project is not changed.

tail.description: Extra seconds after the last bar so tails ring out (default 0).

channel.description:
Channel number, or omitted/null to unroute (a direct out then plays
through its instrument's main mix again).

swap.description:
If the channel already has other sources, move them to this source's
current channel (if it had none, they stay and share the channel).

SampleInfoParams.description: An audio file on the engine host.

path.description:
Relative paths are under the data dir; `upload:<id>` is a finished
upload.

SampleOrigin.description:
Where a region came from: a file on the engine host and the seconds
of it.

SamplePeaksParams.description:
A waveform overview of `start..end` seconds of a file (default: all
of it) in `bins` (min, max) pairs.

SamplePlayParams.description:
Audition `start..end` seconds of a file once, through the engine,
outside the mix (RFC 0011). Without a region, all of a file of at most
60 s; a longer file needs `start`/`end` (at most 60 s apart).

SampleUploadParams.description:
Send a file to the engine host in chunks (from a client on another
machine): the same `upload` id for each, at increasing `offset`s, the
last with `done`. The finished file is checked (it must decode) and
stored under `<data dir>/samples/`.

offset.description: Where this chunk goes in the file (the bytes received so far).

upload.description: Chosen by the client (letters, digits, `-`, `_`; up to 64).

instrument.description: Default: the first sampler.

SamplerLoadParams.description:
Load an audio file (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, AAC/M4A, ALAC, Ogg Vorbis),
or a region of one, into a pad. The file is on the engine host
(`path`), or was just sent with `sample.upload` (`upload`).

path.description: Relative paths are under the data dir; absolute paths as given.

start.description:
The region, in seconds of the file (default: all of it; at most
60 s).

upload.description: A finished upload's id, instead of `path` (journaled as its path).

device.description: A connected device of a known model.

model.description:
The model and its ports to apply; default: the connected ports of
`device`'s model. The daemon journals them, so a replay applies the
same layout where the devices are not connected.

SeatConfig.description: One performer's setup: saved in the project.

focus.description:
Instrument that `focus` bindings, the Block, and following knobs
play. The first instrument if absent.

knob_page.description:
Knob page id; the focused instrument's first page if absent or not
one of its pages.

pitch_bend.description:
Where pitch bend goes: `focus`, an instrument id, or `@<type>`.
Default: the focus.

name.description: Default: the caller's user name (numbered if taken).

saved.description:
Save with the project (default true). False = "ignore": a seat for
this session only.

follow.description: Replaces the device's entry; empty `ccs` removes it.

param.description: Parameter the next CC moved maps to; omit to cancel learning.

page.description: Knob page id of the focused instrument, e.g. `decay`.

channel.description: Only the map on this channel; maps on any channel if omitted.

instrument.description: Drum instrument id; defaults to the first `tr808`.

SongBackParams.description: Return tracks from launched clips to their arrangement.

instrument.description: Default: every track.

now.description: Switch on the next tick instead of waiting for `transport.launch_quantize`.

SongPlaceParams.description: Place a clip on the song timeline; it cuts what it overlaps on the track.

instrument.description: Default: the caller's seat focus.

offset.description: Ticks into the clip it starts at (default 0).

instrument.description: Default: the caller's seat focus.

StepSetParams.description: Edit one step: turn a note on or off, and set or clear expressions on it.

expressions.description: Expressions to set (true) or clear (false), by id (`accent`).

note.description:
The note (a drum voice's or a pitch). On a mono instrument, `null`
with `on: false` makes the step a rest, and a note replaces the
step's note.

types.description: Event types to receive (e.g. `["param_changed"]`). All if omitted.

instrument.description: Drum instrument id; defaults to the first `tr808`.

Defaults to the seat's focus (for `voice`, the first `tr808` unless
the focus is one).

note.description:
MIDI note to play for half a step (a drum machine plays the voice
on that GM note).

Voice.description: The eight TR-808-style drum voices. Order is the track order.

request.description: A typed RPC request. Serialized as `{"method": ..., "params": ...}`.

request.title: Request

backend.description: `cpal` for a real device, `null` for headless real-time pacing.

CcMap.description: Bind one CC to one parameter, scaled over its range.

param.description:
Parameter path; `focus.<param>` follows the seat's focus (e.g.
`focus.cutoff`; nothing when the focus has no such parameter).

pickup.description: Only take over once the knob passes the current value (absolute).

CcMode.description: How a CC's value moves a parameter.

oneOf.description: 0..127 is the parameter's range (a pot or fader).
Endless encoder: 1..63 turn up, 65..127 turn down (127 = -1).

kind.description:
A track channel (instrument outputs feed it) or a return bus (fed by
the track channels' sends, RFC 0010).

oneOf.description: Instrument outputs routed to it.
The track channels' sends (`mixer.<n>.send.<m>`); mixed after them.

Clip.description: A clip in an instrument's pool.

id.description: Its id in the instrument's pool (1, 2, ...).

length.description: Length in ticks (1..`MAX_CLIP_TICKS`): where it loops.

note.description: MIDI note; a drum machine plays the voice on that GM note.

tick.description: Start, in ticks from the clip's start (`PPQ` per quarter note).

ClipPlayhead.description: Where a track is playing: the clip and the tick in it.

base_note.description:
For a pitched focus: the pitch of the bottom row (rows go up a
semitone each).

clip.description: The clip the step grid edits (`steps`), if any.

device.description: Hardware currently attached as a Livid Block, if any.

focus.description:
That seat's focused instrument (its armed track): the grid edits
the clip it is playing, else its selected clip (RFC 0009), and the
knobs control its page.

follow.description: When true, the page follows the playhead while playing.

grid.description:
What the grid shows: the focus's clip as steps, or every track's
clips to launch.

knob_page.description: Knob page in use (an id from `knob_pages`).

knob_params.description: Parameter path each knob currently controls. Empty without focus.

leds.description: 8 rows x 8 columns of LED values (0 = off, 1 = on).

length.description: Steps the grid pages over (the target clip's length in 16ths).

page.description: Which 8-step page the grid shows (0 = steps 1-8, 1 = steps 9-16, ...).

rows.description:
What each grid row is, top first: a drum voice (`BD`), a pitch
(`C2`), or a track (`launch`). Empty rows are blank.

seat.description: The seat the engine host's own devices (the Block) belong to.

DeviceInfo.description: A device that is not an instrument, and where it sits.

channel.description:
Audio effects: the channel whose insert chain holds it (0 = the
master); modulators: none.

position.description:
Its place in that chain (or, a modulator, in the modulator rack),
from 0.

DeviceProfile.description: How a device's input is interpreted.

oneOf.description: Notes and CCs, routed by the seat's bindings and CC maps.
Grid + knobs as a surface for the seat's focus, LEDs driven.

DeviceType.description: A device type that is not an instrument.

oneOf.description: State-variable filter: low, band, or high pass.
Stereo delay, free or tempo-synced, with feedback and ping-pong.
A small Freeverb-style room.
Four LFOs, free or synced to the transport (a modulator).

Graph.description: Instruments, mixer channels, and the routes between them.

devices.description:
Audio effects (RFC 0010), by channel (the master, 0, first) and
their place in its insert chain.

mod_routes.description: Modulation routes, in the order they were made.

routes.description: Source -> channel number. Unrouted sources are absent.

oneOf.description:
The focus's clip: drum rows, or 8 pitch rows from `base_note`;
columns are steps of the current page.

One row per track (up to 8): columns 1-7 launch its clips 1-7, the
last goes back to the arrangement.

layout.description: How its notes show in a step view (RFC 0009).

outputs.description: Main output first, then any direct outs.

InstrumentType.description: An instrument type. Instances are created with `instrument.add`.

oneOf.description: TR-808-style drum machine: eight voices, a step pattern per voice.
TB-303-style bass synth: one monophonic voice, a note pattern.
16 pads, each a sample on its own note (RFC 0010).

KnobFollow.description:
CCs of a device that control the focused instrument's knob page
(knob 1 = the first CC).

Lane.description:
An automation lane (RFC 0010): a parameter's value over the clip, linear
between points (before the first and after the last, the nearest
point's value).

role.description: The port's role in its model (see `MidiDevice::role`).

ModRoute.description:
A modulation route (RFC 0010): a modulator output moving a continuous
parameter by `depth` of its range around the value it is set to.

NoteBinding.description: Route notes from a device into an instrument.

channel.description: MIDI channel 1-16; any channel if absent.

low.description: Lowest and highest input note (inclusive); all notes if absent.

remap.description:
Output note for input notes `low`, `low + 1`, ... (from 0 without
`low`), e.g. pads to drum voices. Overrides `transpose`; a note past
the list plays nothing.

target.description:
An instrument id, `focus` for the seat's focused instrument, or
`@<type>` for the first instrument of a type (`@tr808`).
Alternatives separated by `|` are tried in order: `@tb303|focus`.

NoteExpression.description: How an expression is stored in an event.

oneOf.description:
On when the velocity is at least `min`; setting it writes `on`,
clearing it `off`.

The note is held one tick into the next step, so the next note
starts while it sounds (a 303's slide); clearing it gives the
note its usual gate.

NoteLayout.description: How an instrument's notes show in a step view.

gate.description: A new step's note: its length as a fraction of a step, and velocity.

low.description: Lowest and highest pitch a pitched instrument plays.

mono.description: One note at a time: a step holds at most one note.

rows.description:
Named rows, top first (a drum machine's voices); empty for a pitched
instrument.

NoteRow.description: A named note: one row of a drum machine's grid.

NoteStep.description: One step of a note pattern. `note` is a MIDI number; `None` is a rest.

slide.description: Glide into the next step's note without retriggering.

OutputInfo.description: One routable output of an instrument.

oneOf.description: Always `MAX_STEPS` long.

Placement.description:
A clip placed on the song timeline. It plays from `offset` ticks into
the clip, looping at the clip's length, for `length` ticks.

path.description: Engine-side path of the project bundle, if saved/loaded.

RecordMode.description: How a recording pass treats the notes already in the clip.

oneOf.description: Add to what is there.
Each pass clears the part of the loop it passes over.

RecordState.description:
Recording (RFC 0008): whether a take is running, and the settings the
next one uses.

count_in.description: Bars of metronome before recording from a stop.

instrument.description: The instrument being recorded into, while recording.

offset_ms.description: Extra input latency compensated, in milliseconds.

quantize.description: Record quantize grid in ticks; `None` keeps the played timing.

recording.description: A take is running (the transport plays and notes are recorded).

strength.description: 0..1: how far notes move toward the grid.

user.description: Who started the take (whose undo history it lands in).

SampleOrigin.description:
Where a region came from: a file on the engine host and the seconds
of it.

SamplerPad.description: A loaded pad of a sampler (RFC 0010, regions RFC 0011).

name.description: The file's name, without its folders.

origin.description:
For a project's own copy of a region: the file and region it was
cut from, to edit again if that file is still there.

path.description: Where it is on the engine host.

start.description: The region of the file the pad plays, in seconds.

defaults.description:
Devices on this engine that play here with their model's default
layout (no bindings of the seat's own), as `device (Model)`.

learning.description:
Parameter that the next CC moved on this seat's devices will be
mapped to (`seat.learn_cc`).

occupants.description: Client ids (`name#n`) sitting in this seat.

saved.description: Saved with the project. A seat made with "ignore" is not.

SeatConfig.description: One performer's setup: saved in the project.

focus.description:
Instrument that `focus` bindings, the Block, and following knobs
play. The first instrument if absent.

knob_page.description:
Knob page id; the focused instrument's first page if absent or not
one of its pages.

pitch_bend.description:
Where pitch bend goes: `focus`, an instrument id, or `@<type>`.
Default: the focus.

SeatsState.description: Every seat, and which one the engine host's own devices use.

host.description: Seat of the MIDI devices attached to the engine host.

TrackInfo.description:
An instrument's track: its clip pool, the selected clip (what editors
edit), its arrangement (placements sorted by start, not overlapping),
and the clip it loops instead of its arrangement, if launched (RFC
0009).

launched.description:
The launched clip the track plays instead of its arrangement; null
follows the arrangement.

pending.description:
A launch or a return to the arrangement is waiting for its quantize
boundary (while playing).

TrackPattern.description:
Steps for one track. Each entry is 0 (off), 1 (on), or 2 (accent).
Always `MAX_STEPS` long; the clip's length sets how many are played.

clips.description:
Where each track is playing, by instrument id (tracks playing
nothing are left out), while playing.

step.description: The song position in steps, while playing.

tick.description: The song tick playing, while playing.

Voice.description: The eight TR-808-style drum voices. Order is the track order.

snapshot.description: Full engine state. Subscribers apply events with `seq` greater than this.

moving.description:
Parameters modulation or automation moves, and where they are now
(`params` keeps the values set by hand). RFC 0010.

patterns.description: One step view per instrument, in instrument order.

tracks.description: Each instrument's track (RFC 0008): pool, selection, arrangement.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
